name: Dataset Preprocessing (DeepLesion)
definition: Preprocessing steps for the DeepLesion dataset to prepare tomographic images for training, involving Hounsfield Unit conversion, thresholding, and cropping.
summary: Dataset Preprocessing (DeepLesion) converts raw CT slices to Hounsfield Units, crops out background air using a fixed threshold, and resizes valid regions to 256x256 pixels for generative model training.
